theme: One call on the calendar, and a decision that's run out of runway.
greeting: Morning, Dan — though it's past noon here now. The recruiter intro is behind you and the calendar is nearly clear; today's weight isn't meetings, it's two decisions that have quietly come due.

needsAttention.title: Come to the Carol Hansell call with an ask
needsAttention.detail: The 1:00 catch-up you chased down after Croatia is a warm governance contact — arrive knowing the one or two things you want from it, whether that's board introductions or her read on searches that are live right now.

needsAttention.title: December-break destinations are due
needsAttention.detail: Your own Sept 30 deadline to shortlist three spots for the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four girls. Passports won't be in hand by the Oct 15 book-by date, so the clean answer is a domestic shortlist — pick that lane and move.

needsAttention.title: Hold a Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: The book-this-week rental is now two weeks past due. A refundable full-size SUV at PWM over Christmas week is the thinnest inventory in that market and sells out early — a refundable hold costs nothing and closes the risk.

flagged.title: Shawn Maher (EY) wrote back
flagged.detail: His successor Didem Nisanci is now hired; the thread is warm and open for a short follow-up whenever you want to keep the door ajar.

flagged.title: Nautilus BVI sail invite
flagged.detail: Alumni sail-and-SCUBA offer for you and Mike, one cabin for two — no reply owed, just worth a look.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and alerts — LinkedIn job digests, ICGN and Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, an Amex promo.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is sitting on your reply this morning.

resolved.title: NACD Maine Visionaries ask — you're in
resolved.detail: You told Ellen Richstone "will do" on referring directors; Josh Broder confirmed too, so that one's settled.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell time locked
resolved.detail: After a few rounds, Carol landed on 1 PM and her office sent the link — nothing left to coordinate.

recipe.title: Chanterelle salad
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: The recruiter intro wrapped at 11:30 — the morning's one fixed point is behind you.
A single half-hour call sits in the early afternoon; on either side, the day runs wide open.
Home in St. Pete with the girls, a settled night before tomorrow's table at Pia's.
